---
title: "City2Graph · Build a morphological graph"
---

::: {.lead}
Tessellate Burjassot's building footprints and build the morphological graph
linking private (buildings) and public (streets) space. Mirrors the
[Urban Morphology panel](../../../panels/city2graph/morphology.qmd).
:::

Needs two inputs, both projected to a metric CRS: a **buildings** object
([Import urban data](data.qmd)) and a **street network** object
([OSMnx Download tutorial](../osmnx/download.qmd)).

## 1. Convert segments to a graph

**Segments to Graph** turns the street network into the segment graph the
morphological graph builds on.

![Converting street segments to a graph.](../../../assets/guides/city2graph/02-segments.png)

## 2. Generate the tessellation

**Shrink** (default `0.4`) and **Segment Length** (default `0.5`) control how the
space around buildings is carved into morphological cells.

![Morphological tessellation around the buildings.](../../../assets/guides/city2graph/02-tessellation.png)

## 3. Build the morphological graph

**Center** comes from the active OSMnx object, or enter **Lat/Lon** manually.
**Distance** sets the study radius and **Clipping Buffer** a margin around it.
**Contiguity** picks **Queen** or **Rook** adjacency. The **private↔private**,
**public↔public** and **private↔public** toggles decide which relation families
end up in the result, a heterogeneous graph of building and street nodes.

![The morphological graph linking buildings and streets.](../../../assets/guides/city2graph/02-morphological-graph.png)
